title: Steganography Detection as a Control Primitive: Can Simple Statistical Tests Catch Covert Agent Communication?
original_idea: Test whether chi-squared, entropy analysis, and n-gram frequency checks can detect LLM steganographic communication. Create dataset of LLM outputs with/without steganographic encoding. Measure detection ROC curves.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Addresses a critical multi-agent oversight failure mode. A cheap statistical tripwire deployable at infrastructure layer would be very valuable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Statistical tests are standard. Creating steganographic dataset requires some setup but techniques are documented. ROC curve analysis is basic ML. Well within beginner capability.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear deliverable: ROC curves for each statistical test and a trained classifier. Dataset creation and test implementation are well-defined.
